documents.title: Environmental Physiology

documents.title: Flower & Inflorescence Anatomy

documents.title: Genotype, Phenotype & Variation

documents.title: Hormones & Plant Signaling
documents.summary: Explore auxin, cytokinin, gibberellin, abscisic acid, ethylene, jasmonate and other signals as interacting regulatory networks rather than single-purpose switches.

documents.title: Leaf System

documents.title: Mineral Nutrition & Ion Transport

documents.title: Observation & Differential Diagnostics

documents.title: Photosynthesis & Carbon
documents.summary: Trace light capture, carbon dioxide diffusion, biochemical carbon fixation, carbohydrate production, and the movement of assimilates from source leaves to growing sinks.

documents.title: Root System
documents.summary: Explore primary and lateral roots, fine absorbing roots, root hairs, water and ion uptake, oxygen demand, and the biologically active rhizosphere.

documents.title: Seed & Germination

documents.title: Sex, Pollen, Fertilization & Seed

documents.title: Stem & Vascular System
documents.summary: Connect structural support with xylem water transport, phloem assimilate transport, vascular development, internodes, and the mechanical continuity of the shoot.

documents.title: Stress, Defense & Acclimation
